text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(...Ugh. The underside of a shiitake 
mushroom... Why on earth does it look like 
this—)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(Ngh—no, I shouldn't. Disliking it just 
for its appearance... is rude to the 
shiitake mushroom that became my food...!)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"...With gratitude to the shiitake, to 
those who cultivated them, and to those 
who cooked them so deliciously— Here goes 
nothing... Bon appétit...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Karen Bouquetd'or managed to 
eat it all, but— it seemed to have drained 
quite a lot of her energy...
